historical_record.description: A permit was sought for a two-storey frame church, estimated at $35,000. Jno. J. Foley was named as architect and Barrett & Hilp as contractors. The owner was the Roman Catholic Archbishop of San Francisco.

A building contract was recorded for all work except heating for a church and auditorium building, at $38,000. John J. Foley was named as architect and Barrett & Hilp as contractors. The owner was the Roman Catholic Archbishop of San Francisco.

A building contract was recorded for church pews and screens for a church building. John J. Foley was named as architect and J. Behm & Co. as contractors. The owner was the Roman Catholic Archbishop of San Francisco.
